name: legendary-memory
description: One memory shared across your AI assistants, kept in a file on this computer.
long_description: Start a project in one AI app and continue it in another with no re-explaining. Each project has a living brief, session notes and saved files. Everything is stored in one SQLite file in your home folder (~/.legendary-memory); nothing is sent anywhere and no account is needed.

tools.name: recall
tools.description: Load what is known about a project, or an overview of all projects

tools.name: read
tools.description: Open one stored item in full

tools.name: save_checkpoint
tools.description: Save where a project stands so any assistant can continue it

tools.name: save_artifact
tools.description: Save a file worth keeping with a project

tools.name: remember
tools.description: Store a lasting fact about you

tools.name: forget
tools.description: Delete one stored item when you ask
